decisions.reason: Staging campaign leads in a Google Sheet before CRM transfer does not change HubSpot properties, stages, categorization, lists, notes, nurturing, or task assignment.
The import workflow does not change whether email and LinkedIn communication history is visible in HubSpot.
The Google Sheet staging step does not alter the deferred Contact Source funnel reporting requirement or its reporting fields.
Recording leads in a Google Sheet before transfer does not change the selected HubSpot platform, Starter subscription, or intended CRM use.
The source concerns initial lead recording and CRM transfer, not synchronization of MeetAlfred reply status into HubSpot.
The staging workflow does not resume or change the deferred automation for moving silent leads into MeetAlfred follow-up campaigns.
A Google Sheet staging step does not necessarily change the requirement to show whether a LinkedIn prospect is already in the CRM.
The source does not change the required type of LinkedIn profile URL stored for a lead.
The source describes transferring leads into the CRM, whereas this candidate governs transfer of HubSpot lists and leads from HubSpot to MeetAlfred.
The source does not concern integration testing or authorize use of production, replacement, or MeetAlfred leads for tests.
The Google Sheet-to-CRM workflow does not change MeetAlfred configuration requirements or its Pro subscription plan.
The source does not change the procedure for provisioning a new MeetAlfred campaign with a duplicated Zap and HubSpot leads.
